description: This file defines the HtmlTag class, a render element for generating HTML tags with properties such as tag name, attributes, and content, including handling void elements and optional noscript wrapping.

classes.name: HtmlTag
classes.description: A render element class for rendering customizable HTML tags with attributes and content, supporting void elements and optional noscript wrapping.
